settings.hero_title: Functional gummies held to the standard of
settings.hero_text: Most of us want the same things: a clear head, steady energy and a good night's sleep. Yet most gummies made for those goals are candy first: built on pectin and sugar, brightly colored, and dosed to fit the gummy rather than the research. Reserve Nutrition exists to make the opposite: functional gummies set in grass-fed gelatin, flavored with real fruit, and dosed to match the studies behind them.

settings.philo_text: A gummy is something you eat every day, so we hold it to the standard of food. That starts with 100% grass-fed beef gelatin instead of the pectin most gummies are built on, real fruit for flavor, and formulas developed with our formulator around the doses used in human research.
settings.mission_title: To make functional gummies clean enough to take every day, and dosed well enough to be worth it.
settings.trust_text: Supplements don't need FDA approval before they're sold, and it shows. Proprietary blends hide the numbers, and finished products don't always match their labels. You deserve to know exactly what you're taking, so we print every dose and have our finished products independently tested.

settings.approach_title: Where the research meets the kitchen.
settings.approach_text: Every Reserve formula starts with the evidence and finishes in the kitchen. We choose each ingredient for its human research and set it at the dose studied, then refine flavor, texture and stability with our formulator until the result is something you would enjoy even if it did nothing at all.
settings.range_title: One standard, carried into every formula.
settings.range_text: Cognition is our first release. More formulas are on the way, each held to the same standard.
